items.title: Sudhalter interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: I got to play, and at some point I had an all-women band.

ctx.x: Internment camps for Japanese here in this country. And even then, within the camp, she was organizing people into bands so that sort of tells you something.
Yeah. So I did, I got to play, and at some point I had an all-women band.
